method: One cold claude -p CLI session (claude-opus-5), resumed once per image with the identical analysis prompt used for the Sonnet run, against the SAME 15 PNGs in ../vision-sonnet/shots/. Per-image numbers are the CLI reported usage for that turn. No capture phase preceded analysis; first turn carries the one-time system-prompt cache write.
